name: Nachi-Fujikoshi Corp.
summary: Nachi-Fujikoshi Corp. manufactures and sells machine tools, parts, and other products in Japan, Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company provides cutting tools, including drills, taps, end mills, and precision tools; machine tools, such as skiving machining center for gears, broaching machines, precision roll forming machines, grinding machines, power finishers, and machining cells; and robots that include handling, palletizing, spot welding, heavy duty, cleanroom, and controllers.
